originalCaption:
We are pleased to announce our 3rd National Youth Advocacy Program! We invite youth and young adults to join us for this valuable opportunity to develop advocacy skills, engage in civic participation, and gain firsthand experience in our nation’s capital.

Please see the flyer or click on the link below for registration and more information on the program. We look forward to having you join us!

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/zNcxH40y3D
factualSummary: KOA publicly announced its 3rd National Youth Advocacy Program and invited youth and young adults to develop advocacy skills, participate in civic life, and gain experience in the nation’s capital. The post supplies a registration link.
